evals.prompt: triage: the login page crashes when entering special characters in the password field
evals.expected_output: Triage flow invoked with the bug description, scope check performed, work item created
expectations: Processes the issue description through the triage flow
Checks doc/requirements.md for scope
Searches for duplicate work items before creating
Creates a well-structured bug work item with severity and reproduction steps
Detects empty arguments
Presents the 3-option menu (describe, transcript from Drive, paste)
Waits for user choice before proceeding
Does not create work items until user provides input

evals.prompt: triage: we need a dark mode toggle in the settings page
evals.expected_output: Scope check identifies this as potentially out-of-scope, proposes requirement change
expectations: Processes the feature request through the triage flow
Reads doc/requirements.md to check scope
If out of scope, halts work item creation and proposes requirement change
Waits for user approval before proceeding

evals.prompt: triage a Google Meet transcript from yesterday's planning meeting
evals.expected_output: Fetches transcript from Drive, extracts action items, triages each individually
expectations: Searches Google Drive for recent Meet transcripts
Presents the 5 most recent transcripts for user selection
Extracts distinct issues from the transcript
Presents all proposed work items as a batch for review before creating

evals.prompt: file a bug: API returns 500 error on the /users endpoint when pagination exceeds 100
evals.expected_output: Bug work item created with proper fields referencing the violated requirement
expectations: Recognizes this as a bug report
Bugs are always in scope — references the requirement the bug violates
Creates work item with clear title, description, steps to reproduce
Includes severity classification and suggests assignee
